label: 510(k) Medical Device — Biocompatibility Evaluation
description: Biocompatibility evaluation per ISO 10993-1 for NeuroSense Pro electrode headset.

inputs.device_name: NeuroSense Pro Continuous EEG Monitor — Electrode Headset
inputs.contact_duration: Prolonged (>24 hours to 30 days) — intended for continuous ICU monitoring
inputs.iso_category: Surface device, intact skin contact, prolonged duration
inputs.mat_1_grade: Medical device grade, ISO 13485 certified supplier
inputs.mat_3_contact: Indirect contact (housing, no skin contact during normal use)
inputs.cyto_result: Grade 0 (no cytotoxic effects) — L-929 mouse fibroblast, MEM elution, 24h
inputs.sens_result: Non-sensitizing — Guinea pig maximization test (Magnusson & Kligman), 0% sensitization rate
inputs.syst_result: Not required — surface device, intact skin
inputs.geno_result: Not required — surface device, intact skin, prolonged duration
inputs.biocompat_conclusions: The NeuroSense Pro electrode headset materials are biocompatible for the intended use (surface contact, intact skin, prolonged duration). All required biological endpoints (cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation) meet acceptance criteria per ISO 10993. The material composition is consistent with well-established medical device materials with extensive clinical history.
